components.name: Avatar
components.description: Profile picture with a text fallback. `src` shows an image; until it loads, or without one, `fallback` (or children) shows instead, usually initials. `status` pins a presence dot to the bottom corner.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Shown while the image loads or when there is none. Children work too.

components.name: AvatarGroup
components.description: Overlapping row of avatars. With `max`, shows that many and a "+N" avatar for the rest. `size` applies to every avatar that does not set its own.

examples.title: shape square
examples.code:
<Stack direction="row" align="center" className="gap-3">
  <Avatar shape="square">AC</Avatar>
  <Avatar shape="square" size="lg" src={PORTRAIT_SRC} fallback="AC" />
</Stack>
